verses.text: A shoot will grow from the stump of Jesse, and a branch from his roots will bear fruit.
The Spirit of the LORD will rest on him: the Spirit of wisdom and understanding, the Spirit of good advice and strength, the Spirit of knowledge and deep respect for the LORD.
He will delight in respecting the LORD. He will not judge by what he sees with his eyes, or decide by what he hears with his ears.

Instead, he will judge the poor fairly and make right decisions for the humble people of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his words, and with the breath of his lips he will kill the wicked.
Righteousness will be like a belt around his waist, and faithfulness like a belt around his hips.
The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat. The calf, the young lion, and the fattened calf will be together, and a little child will lead them.
The cow and the bear will eat together. Their young will lie down together. The lion will eat straw like the ox.
A baby will play near the hole of a cobra, and a young child will put their hand into the nest of a poisonous snake.
They will not hurt or destroy anything on all my holy mountain. For the earth will be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
On that day the root of Jesse will stand as a flag for the peoples. The nations will come looking for him, and the place where he rests will be glorious.
On that day the Lord will reach out his hand a second time to bring back the survivors of his people from Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Cush, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, and the islands of the sea.
He will raise a flag for the nations. He will gather the people of Israel who were driven out, and bring together the scattered people of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
Ephraim's jealousy will disappear, and the enemies of Judah will be cut off. Ephraim will not be jealous of Judah, and Judah will not be hostile toward Ephraim.

They will swoop down on the slopes of the Philistines to the west. Together they will take treasure from the people of the east. They will take control of Edom and Moab, and the people of Ammon will obey them.

The LORD will completely dry up the gulf of the Egyptian sea. With his scorching wind he will sweep his hand over the Euphrates River. He will split it into seven streams, so that people can walk across in sandals.
There will be a highway for the survivors of his people coming from Assyria, just as there was for Israel when they came up out of the land of Egypt.
